cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies admitted for delivery
finding: Compared to pre-pandemic periods, pregnant women who wore masks during the COVID-19 pandemic had higher hemoglobin and fibrinogen levels, lower platelet levels, a lower rate of preterm delivery, and higher rates of cesarean delivery and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: The study found a higher rate of cesarean delivery among women who wore masks during labor during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to those who did not.
